title: Evaluating the Safety and Skill Reasoning of Large Reasoning Models Under Compute Constraints
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the performance and safety of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) under compute constraints, such as quantization and reasoning length. While it uses safety evaluation datasets (like StrongReject) to measure jailbreak resistance, it does not specifically evaluate religion, faith, or spiritual/ethical systems as a core component of its benchmarking.
